main.welcome_html: Welcome to New World. This is a starter sprite and a first line of dialog. Type a message and your character will appear.

main.err_select_llm: Please set an LLM provider in config

tool_confirmation.timeout: Tool {tool} was cancelled because confirmation timed out.

error.unauthorized: Download failed: authentication expired or access token is missing. Check your Hugging Face token or network proxy and try again.

error.not_found: Download failed: resource not found or model name is invalid. Check the download URL.
error.rate_limited: Download failed: too many requests or rate limited. Please try again later.
error.timeout: Download timed out: check your network, proxy, or mirror settings and try again.
error.proxy_error: Download failed: proxy connection error. Check your system proxy or Shinsekai network proxy settings.

error.http_status: Download failed: server returned HTTP {status}. Check your network, permissions, or mirror.
error.generic: Download failed: check your network, proxy, or mirror settings, or try again later.

err.llm_model_required: Please enter the LLM model ID first.
err.plugin_slot_display_only: This plugin slot is display-only and has no executable action.

plugin_ui.moondream_desc: Captures screenshots via mss and loads Moondream2 via Hugging Face Transformers. Automatic screen vision uses trigger-specific English prompts with a minimum inference interval.
plugin_ui.moondream_restart_hint: Restart the chat runtime after changing model ID, device, quantization, or cache directory to reload weights.
plugin_ui.moondream_model_section_desc: The first inference after enabling downloads model weights to your Hugging Face cache. INT8 / INT4 requires an NVIDIA GPU + CUDA + bitsandbytes.
plugin_ui.moondream_enabled: Enable screen vision (diff / mouse / window triggers)
plugin_ui.moondream_cache_dir_ph: Optional; leave blank to use default HF cache
plugin_ui.moondream_quantization_desc: INT8 / INT4 requires NVIDIA CUDA and bitsandbytes; incompatible with Apple MPS / CPU.
plugin_ui.moondream_motion_poll_desc: Polling interval for mouse, window, and thumbnail diff; smaller values react faster with slightly higher CPU usage.
plugin_ui.moondream_diff_threshold_desc: Changed pixel ratio threshold relative to the last successful capture thumbnail.
plugin_ui.moondream_mouse_move_desc: Movement distance ratio relative to the larger monitor dimension before counting as activity.
plugin_ui.moondream_interval_sec_desc: Minimum interval in seconds between two model inferences.
plugin_ui.moondream_monitor_index_desc: mss: 0 = combined virtual screen; 1 is usually the primary physical monitor.
plugin_ui.moondream_infer_max_side_desc: Resize the longer screenshot edge to this pixel size before Moondream inference; 0 disables resizing.
plugin_ui.moondream_prompts_title: English Prompts (per trigger; leave blank for built-in defaults)
plugin_ui.playwright_desc: Chromium / Firefox / WebKit require `playwright install`; Edge / Chrome use your system browser without extra downloads. Restart after changes.
plugin_ui.playwright_restart_hint: Restart the chat runtime after changing browser settings to recreate the browser session.
